description: This file declares the interface IControllerFactory for creating IPC controller objects within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace. It includes a factory method to create instances and a method to create a RpcController, utilizing Google Protocol Buffers. The file is part of an IPC component for the Rialto project, defining a key factory interface for IPC controller creation.

classes.name: IControllerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating IPC controller objects, providing a static method to create factory instances and a pure virtual method to create RpcController objects.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControllerFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create and return a shared pointer to a google::protobuf::RpcController object.
